For the other 11 steps check_artifacts() returns no errors, so a
non-zero exit (e.g. a failed Baum-Welch step) prints a WARNING and
training continues; log patterns "failed"/"Aborting" are warnings
too. Only "0 frames"/"FATAL" in a step's logdir stop the run.
